The '''YT-1220''' was a type of [[Starship/Legends|starship]] that was used during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The [[Tourism Council of Oluna Biqua]] owned one, called the ''[[Headliner]]''.
